statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is constructed by summing the two distinct line items from the reconciliation of net profit to cash generated from operations (Note 43(a)): 'Depreciation of property, plant and equipment, investment properties and right-of-use assets' and 'Amortisation of intangible assets and land use rights'. These are the standard non-cash add-backs for this field. All other requested fields (e.g., total_operating_cost, taxes, interest_expenses, marketable_securities) were not present in the provided statement or supplementary tables, so their arrays are empty as per the schema. The scale is 1E6 (millions) as indicated by '(Amounts in RMB' Million)'. The currency is CNY (Renminbi).
